exact_somali: Wuxuuna u balan qaaday in ay inta awoda Jaamacadda ah laga caawin doono.
source_title: Raktarka Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed oo Warbixin ka dhagaystay Naadiga Ardayda Jaamacadda.
attested_fact: The exact surface Wuxuuna occurs at the beginning of a new orthographic sentence in an official Somali National University publication.
linguistic_interpretation: Independent distributional attestation for sentence-initial Wuxuuna. Existing project sources, not this corpus item, provide its morphological segmentation and subject-clitic analysis.
project_rule_relevance: GRAM-CONNWAXAA-002 and GRAM-CONNWAXAA-007 already license independently attested exact reviewed waxaa-family connectives at input start; GRAM-CONNWAXAA-005 already reviews exact wuxuuna.
test_expectation: analyze_connective_waxaa_focus should recognize exact sentence-initial Wuxuuna with boundary input_start and the already-reviewed uu/3sg_m profile. Predicate agreement may remain unjudged unless exact reviewed finite morphology is found.
training_evaluation_usefulness: Positive holdout/regression item for clause-boundary recognition without inventing morphology.
proves: Sentence-initial occurrence of the exact Wuxuuna surface in this source.
does_not_prove: It does not by itself prove the segmentation of wuxuuna, a full connective paradigm, the correctness of every clause beginning wuxuuna, or the person/tense features of later words.

exact_somali: Wuxuuna iyaga ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan masaalkan garanaynin?
attested_fact: The exact surface Wuxuuna occurs at the beginning of Markos 4:13 in the published Somali translation.
linguistic_interpretation: A second independent attestation of sentence-initial Wuxuuna, used only to corroborate surface distribution.
project_rule_relevance: Corroborates the input-start distribution already stated by GRAM-CONNWAXAA-002/007 for independently attested exact reviewed connectives.
test_expectation: analyze_connective_waxaa_focus should recognize exact sentence-initial Wuxuuna with boundary input_start. No new verb analysis is required by this test.
training_evaluation_usefulness: Independent positive regression item from a different publication domain.
proves: Sentence-initial occurrence of exact Wuxuuna in this source.
does_not_prove: It does not license unseen connective forms, establish a productive paradigm, or prove that yidhi or any other predicate has a particular morphology unless separately reviewed.

exact_somali: Waxaadna ogaataan in dib u eegis lagu samaynayo Xeerka Ciqaabta ee soo baxay sannadkii 1964-tii, si loo xaqiijiyo inaan loo adeegsan weriye kasta.
source_title: Farriinta Madaxweynaha JFS ee Xuska Maalinta Xorriyadda Saxaafadda ee Adduunka
source_author_or_institution: Villa Somalia — Office of the President of the Federal Republic of Somalia
attested_fact: The exact surface Waxaadna occurs sentence-initially in an official presidential publication.
linguistic_interpretation: Independent positive control for the input-start behavior already implemented for exact waxaadna.
project_rule_relevance: Exercises GRAM-CONNWAXAA-002/005/007 using a sentence not used to derive the rule.
test_expectation: The exact connective should be recognized at input_start with the already-reviewed aad 2sg/2pl person set. Agreement must not be guessed if the following predicate lacks exact reviewed morphology.
training_evaluation_usefulness: Positive control and future evaluation example for separating connective recognition from morphology certainty.
proves: Sentence-initial occurrence of exact Waxaadna in this source.
does_not_prove: It does not independently establish the aad person mapping or the morphology of ogaataan; those require separate evidence.

exact_somali: Iyadoo laga ambaqaadayo go’aankii Ra’iisul Wasaaraha XFS ee ahaa in cid kasta ay ka qayb qaadato Dagaalka lagu ciribtirayo Khawaarijta ayay Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Kheyradka Biyaha isugu yimaadeen kulankan waxa ayna ballanqaadeen in taageero hiil iyo hooba ay la garab taaganyihiin Ciidanka Qaranka.
source_author_or_institution: Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Kheyraadka Biyaha XFS
attested_fact: The source contains the separated written sequence waxa ayna in connected prose.
linguistic_interpretation: This is an attested nearby written surface. This QA item does not decide whether project orthography should normalize or equate it with waxayna.
project_rule_relevance: GRAM-CONNWAXAA-004 limits this analyzer to independently reviewed exact executable connective surfaces and forbids productive generation or silent analogy.
test_expectation: The exact-surface connective analyzer should not silently convert the two-token sequence waxa ayna into exact waxayna. It should remain unrecognized/unjudged here pending separate orthography/variant review.
training_evaluation_usefulness: Adversarial safety item testing whether the engine overgeneralizes from an attested exact surface to a nearby spelling/segmentation variant.
proves: The separated sequence waxa ayna is attested in this source.
does_not_prove: It does not prove that the separated spelling is preferred, equivalent in every context, erroneous, or eligible for automatic normalization.

exact_somali: Dowladda ayaa Cisbitaalka Martini oo ah Cisbitaalkii ugu horeeyey ee bukaannda COVID-19 lagu daweeyo waxay ku diyaarisay qalabkii loo baahnaa in lagu daaweeyo bukaamada uu xanuunkani haleelay, ayaa gebogebo marsiinaysa diyaarinta cisbitaalkii labaad oo loo qorsheeyay in lagula tacaalo bukaannada COVID-19 lagu daweeyo waxayna qorsheyneysaa hirgelinta Isbitaalo kale oo dheeraad ah.
source_title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Khayre: Qalab Caafimaad Oo Dibdda Aan Ka Dalbannay Ayaa Dhawaan Dalka Soo Gaaraya, Waxaana Loo Qaybinayaa Dowlad Gobaleedyada
attested_fact: The exact surface waxayna occurs in a long, unpunctuated local transition inside an official Somali government sentence.
linguistic_interpretation: Useful context-sensitive corpus evidence. The sentence is not used to broaden the analyzer's conservative reviewed-left-finite boundary heuristic.
project_rule_relevance: Stress-tests whether failure to license a conservative executable boundary is kept distinct from claiming that attested Somali is grammatically wrong.
test_expectation: No automatic grammar-error or punctuation-repair claim should be derived solely from this corpus item's complex boundary. A stronger executable expectation requires separate review of the local predicates and syntax.
training_evaluation_usefulness: Context-required/abstention item for future QA of complex clause coordination.
proves: Attestation of exact waxayna in this published context.
does_not_prove: It does not prove that every unpunctuated mid-sentence waxayna must be executable under the current heuristic, nor does it establish the analysis of surrounding predicates.
